description: Solar PV yield API, no API key: annual and monthly kWh for any kWp system at any location, optimal tilt and azimuth, roof-face comparison (south/east/west/flat) and payback from your electricity price. EU JRC PVGIS 5.3 satellite data 2005-2023, Europe, Africa, Asia and the Americas, up to 50 locations per call. Monitor mode returns only new or changed estimates. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.02 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/solar-pv-yield-api.

azimuthCompass.description: Direction the panels face as a compass bearing: 180 = south, 90 = east, 270 = west, 0 = north. Leave empty to optimize.

currency.description: Currency label for the money fields (e.g. EUR, USD, GBP). No conversion is done.

electricityPrice.description: Your price per kWh (e.g. 0.25). Adds annualValue and lifetimeValue25y (0.5%/year panel degradation).

locations.description: One location per line as 'lat,lon' or 'lat,lon,label' (decimal degrees, e.g. 51.5072,-0.1276,London). Max 50 per run. Points at sea or outside PVGIS coverage get a row with an error field.

mode.description: yield = annual kWh, monthly list, best/worst month and money values per location; monthly = 12 rows per location; compare = for the first location only, rows for optimal, flat and 30-degree south/east/west faces with % versus the best.

mounting.description: free = free-standing rack (better cooling); building = integrated in the roof or facade (hotter, a bit less output).

optimize.description: When tilt/azimuth are not given, find the angles with the highest yearly output (equator-facing). Off = 30 degrees facing the equator.

peakPowerKw.description: Installed peak power of the PV system in kWp (e.g. 5 for a home roof, 500 for a commercial roof).

systemCost.description: Total installed cost in the same currency. With an electricity price adds simple paybackYears and costPerKwp.

systemLossPercent.description: Cable, inverter and dirt losses in percent. PVGIS recommends 14.

technology.description: Module technology: crystSi = crystalline silicon (most panels), CIS, CdTe or Unknown.

tilt.description: Panel tilt from horizontal (0 = flat, 90 = vertical). Leave empty to optimize.

tracking.description: Fixed panels (none) or a sun-tracking system: single inclined axis, single vertical axis or two-axis.

title: Solar PV Yield API - kWh per Month, Payback, No Key
